name: project-planning-repo
description: Set up and maintain a private `project/` delivery-planning repo beside a multi-repo project: cross-repo ARCHITECTURE + BACKLOG, temp handoffs with clean-when headers, closed-ticket archive, sync-on-fetch and never-referenced-from-repos rules, optional GitHub Issues tracking with a generated backlog snapshot, periodic 7-day treeshake of memory, temp/, local/ and docs.
